rubric.role_summary: Senior capital formation role at a venture capital firm, covering institutional investor relationships and fundraising while supporting co-investment syndication and deal execution.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Senior capital formation role at a venture capital firm, covering institutional investor relationships and fundraising while supporting co-investment syndication and deal execution.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 5+ years of experience in investment banking, a placement agent firm, management consulting, or a dedicated investor relations/business development role within private equity.
- Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets for financial modeling and PowerPoint/Google Slides.
- Bachelor’s degree in finance, economics, commerce, or a related field.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- High proficiency using AI productivity tools to streamline workflows and accelerate content development.
- Experience with HubSpot, Deal Cloud, or similar CRM workflows for pipeline tracking.
- High proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets for financial modeling and metrics and PowerPoint/Google Slides, supported by strong technical experience managing and interpreting large data sets, data analysis, data mining, and pattern recognition.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Location: Greater Toronto, Ontario, Canada area. Hybrid work is based in this area, and candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
